title: CapyMate
tagline: CapyMate is an Autonomous Trading Agent that takes decisions based on Sentiment Analysis
description: CapyMate is an autonomous Web3 AI agent designed to act as a crypto portfolio manager/trader. It aims to solve the problem of emotional trading by dynamically rebalancing a user's assets based on real-time market news sentiment analysis.The identity/image of CapyMate is a capybara enjoying a traditional "mate" (note the pun from the argentinian beverage and the english word heh) This mascot tries to make the experience more user friendly.
how_its_made:
CapyMate was built using a modular, off-chain architecture, where we feed market/crypto news to an LLM for sentiment analysis with our agent harness.
Once the AI decides to take action, we use the following integrations
Uniswap Routing API to dynamically fetch the optimal quote and calldata for the trade.
KeeperHub to minimize the attack surface in AI trading with their private execution layer
0G Storage to act as the agent's immutable memory. After the trade is made, the LLM raw reasoning is meant to be uploaded to the blockchain for transparency.
